The '''feedforward algorithm''' is an [[algorithm]] used in a multi-layer [[artificial neural network (ANN)]] to calculate the value of the next layer of [[artificial neuron]]s.

== Mathematical formulation ==

[[File:Layer-layer calculation in ANN.png|thumbnail|]]
Given an input vector $\vec a^{(0)} \in \mathbb{R}^n$ consisting values of the [[artificial neurons]] of layer 0, a weight matrix $\mathbf{W} \in \mathbb{R}^m \times \mathbb{R}^n$, and a bias vector $\vec b \in \mathbb{R}^m$, the value of the next layer

$$
\vec a^{(1)} = f(\mathbf{W}\vec a^{(0)} + \vec b)
$$

Where $f$ is the activation function, often the [[sigmoid function]].

In matrix form:

$$
\vec a^{(1)} =
f \left(
\begin{pmatrix}
w_{0,0} & w_{0,1} & \cdots & w_{0,n} \\
w_{1,0} & w_{1,1} & \cdots & w_{1,n} \\
\vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
w_{m,0} & w_{m,1} & \cdots & w_{m,n}
\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix}
a^{(0)}_0 \\
a^{(0)}_1 \\
\vdots \\
a^{(0)}_n
\end{pmatrix}
+
\begin{pmatrix}
b_0 \\
b_1 \\
\vdots \\
b_m
\end{pmatrix}
\right)
$$

== Implementation ==

=== Python ===

<syntaxhighlight lang="python">
def feedforward(self, a):
    """Feedforward input vector a to a_1"""
    for b, w in zip(self.biases, self.weights):
        a_1 = sigmoid(np.dot(w, a) + b)
    return a_1
</syntaxhighlight>
